name: WhatsApp
description: WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration for ActonOS AI agents with text, template messaging, and agent routing
author: ActonOS

poll_interval_seconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Delay in seconds between webhook-queue drain cycles

accounts.title: Bot Accounts
accounts.description: Configure one or multiple WhatsApp Cloud phone numbers

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance used for routing and session isolation

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this WhatsApp number

access_token.title: System User Access Token
access_token.description: Meta Graph API permanent access token with whatsapp_business_messaging permission

phone_number_id.title: Phone Number ID
phone_number_id.description: WhatsApp Cloud API Phone Number ID from Meta Developer Console

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @mention is present

enable_typing_indicator.title: Live Typing Indicator
enable_typing_indicator.description: Mark the inbound message as read and show a typing indicator while the agent replies

enable_ack_reaction.title: Acknowledge with Reaction
enable_ack_reaction.description: React to the user's WhatsApp message to acknowledge receipt

enable_reply_quote.title: Quote / Thread Reply
enable_reply_quote.description: Attach outbound replies with context.message_id quoting the user's prompt
